title: Second order unfitted ghost-FEM for elliptic interface problems with applications to low-dimensional semiconductor devices
summary: We develop an unfitted ghost finite element method for elliptic interface problems with discontinuous diffusion coefficients and apply it to the electrostatic simulation of low-dimensional semiconductor devices. The proposed approach is based on a fixed Cartesian grid and represents the geometry by level-set functions, avoiding mesh generation and remeshing even in the presence of interfaces.
